$comment: BC Transit's Nanaimo Regional Transit System, published through Consat (tmix.se) as operator 41. Mobility Database links its schedule (mdb-2473), alerts (mdb-2474), trip updates (mdb-2475), and vehicle positions (mdb-2476): https://mobilitydatabase.org/feeds/gtfs_rt/mdb-2476 (checked 2026-10-28). Every route is drawn; overrides: routes.json. Region: nanaimo. Terms: https://www.bctransit.com/open-data/terms-of-use/.
name: BC Transit (Nanaimo)

static.$comment: The 2026-10-28 export has a daily feed_version, calendar_dates.txt only, and shape_dist_traveled in metres, like BC Transit's Victoria and Kelowna feeds. fetch-gtfs archives a new version only when the timetable differs from the newest archived one. How often it changes is open (config/regions/nanaimo/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #1).

realtime.$comment: The positions, trip updates, and alerts endpoints returned protobuf on 2026-10-28. No API key or stated request limit. Polling and age thresholds are assumptions shared with the other BC Transit feeds (config/regions/nanaimo/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #2).

display.$tripId: The Consat trip id begins with the journey id, as in BC Transit's other feeds. Confirm against Nanaimo recordings (config/regions/nanaimo/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #3).
display.$feedVersion: The 2026-10-28 feed version begins with an export date and sequence number, before slash-separated export times.
